statement: theorem regret_zero_diameter (V : Domain (E := E)) (α : ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E)) (hx₁ : x₁ ∈ V.carrier) (T : ℕ) (hdiam : ∀ x ∈ V.carrier, ∀ y ∈ V.carrier, ‖x - y‖ ≤ (0 : ℝ)) (u : E) (hu : u ∈ V.carrier) : regret V α 0 loss x₁ p u T = 0 ∧ ‖output V α 0 loss x₁ p T - u‖ = 0
